notes: All traffic and storage scenario inputs are assumptions, not scan measurements.
Monthly active users are modelled as a share of the 12-month company-reported Active Member population.
Event storage uses modelled MAU multiplied by assumed events per MAU per month and a retention window; profile storage uses the 12-month Active Member population.

No cloud/database cost estimate is generated because the public scan does not reveal provider, architecture, resource sizing, utilisation or negotiated prices. Use public disclosed technology investment only as a broad company spending envelope, not as infrastructure spend.
